reapack.name: Dubbing_Prompter.lua
reapack.desc: Dubbing Prompter: subtitles, roles and takes for dubbing

metadata.description: Workstation for dubbing sound directors: prompter with the current line, subtitle import (SRT/ASS/SSA/VTT/TXT or tracks embedded in MKV/MP4 via ffmpeg), roles, recorded marks, takes, regions and text items synced with the cursor. Works together with Dubbing_SubOverlay.lua.

version.changelog: Menus no longer click the button under them; the replica list scrolls to the current replica; file dialogs remember the last folder; F1-F5 switch screens directly (F5 = text with the top bar), F6 = help.
